svg.text: Lid 96 x 60 x 10 mm. Measure from the front edge and the centre line.

svg.text: Chlorine gland: tap M25 x 1.5, 24 left of centre, 35 from the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spare pH port: tap M20 x 1.5, 14 right of centre, 37 from the front;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fit the blanking plug (or a gland for the pH probe variant).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Temperature gland: tap M12 x 1.5, 34 right, 23 from the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stud holes 4.5 mm at 44 each side, 4 and 53 from the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gasket: same outline, 80 x 38 window centred 27 from the front,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four 4.5 mm stud holes; cut from 1.5 mm EPDM.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M4 studs in the body, gasket, lid, four knurled thumb

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nuts, finger tight. The lid lifts off with the sensors in it.
